...THIRD INNINGS...

Pakistan will be happy they they didn't let the tail wag much. They started the third session really well by taking the wickets of Rahim, Hasan and then the tail. However, it didn't come easily as they had to grind hard under scorching heat and not much assistance from the pitch. The seamers shined for them. Naseem Shah ended with three wickets while Afridi, Shahzad and Ali ended with two each. Pakistan have more than hours to bat now and will hope not to lose any wickets till the end of the day. Stay tuned.

Shoriful Islam's quick cameo helps Bangladesh stretch the lead to 117 runs. A solid show from Bangladesh with the bat. They were 53/2 at one stage but then came some marathon innings and a couple of big partnerships for them. Shadman Islam at the top along with Mominul Haque. Mushfiqur Rahim along with Litton Das first and then Mehidy Hasan. However, Mushfiqur Rahim's 191 was the highlight of all of them. The veteran stepped up and played a brilliant innings to help Bangladesh take a decent lead.

OUT! GONE! Islam goes and that is the end of Bangladesh. A slower length ball, outside off, Shoriful Islam looks to heave but mistimes it to deep mid-wicket where Abdullah Shafique takes it. Bangladesh end with 565.

A wicketless session for Bangladesh and they have added another 106 runs to their tally while also taking the lead of 47 runs. Mushfiqur Rahim looks unstoppable as he goes past his 150 alongside Mehidy Hasan, silently playing a fine innings. Pakistan look clueless at the moment. They did create a couple of chances in this session but none that could help them get the breakthrough. The final session is coming up. The pitch is still a glory track for the batters and Bangladesh will look to take their lead over 100 now. For Pakistan, their tireless work rate seems to be in ascendency but without any reward. Stay tuned for the final session.

Commentary.Commentary: The progress for Bangladesh has been slow but quite steady! They have done well so far with the bat! They only trail by another 132 runs and have five wickets in hand. Both Das and Rahim are set and they would hope the two can bat and go big. Pakistan on the other hand, know they are only a couple of wickets away from entering the tail. They'll be desperate to break this stand quickly. Can their bowlers come to the fore? We will find out.
... DAY 4, SESSION 1 ...

Bangladesh started the day with all their wickets in hand but they lost Zakir Hasan and Najmul Hossain Shanto in quick spell. Shadman Islam and Mominul Haque then built a strong partnership of 94 runs before the latter fell after his fifty. Mushfiqur Rahim then added 52 along with Islam who missed out on his century by 7 runs as he fell right at the stroke of Tea. Pakistan have let this game slip a bit. They were in commanding position for a long time, taking wickets regularly but these on-going partnership have damped their hopes of bundling Bangladesh out for a low score. Can they pick up wickets quickly tomorrow on Day 4 or this partnership will rally? Join us at 5 am GMT for all the action. Till then, cheers!

The partnership between Litton Das and Mushfiqur Rahim has put this game back to even balance. What a stand, what an innings actually from Litton Das who came out all guns blazing and targetted Naseem Shah mostly to get to his fifty. Mushfiqur Rahim on the other hand has played a sensible, more experienced knock and to his credit has done an amazing job to build a stand with a couple of Bangladeshi players.

A length ball on middle and leg, nips in sharply. Mushfiqur Rahim misses his flick and gets hit high on the pads. Pakistan unconfidently take it upstairs. UltraEdge shows there is a thick inside edge. Pakistan have lost all their review. STUMPS!

TEA! The wicket of Shadman Islam will bring some smiles on the Pakistani players. They have toiled hard and have been tight with their lines and lengths. Shan Masood started this session with spin from one end and Khurram Shahzad from the other side. Islam survived an LBW scare, but Khurram Shahzad got rid of Haque after his fine fifty. Pakistan started the session well with two wickets as the ball moved slightly. Naseem Shah and Shaheen Afridi bowled really well in the start and Khurram Shahzad kept the pressure going as well but as the ball got older, it got difficult for the Pakistani bowlers to create any sort of pressure. This is what Bangladesh had to go through and it's Pakistani players to grind hard under the scorching sun. Still, Bangladesh trail by 314 runs. Join us back at 9 am GMT for the second session.

LUNCH! Mominul Haque and Shadman Islam have added 81 runs together. A solid partnership for Bangladesh and just what they wanted as well. They lost Zakir Hasan early on and Khurram Shahzad came up with an absolute beauty to get rid of Shanto later. It felt like Bangladesh will find it difficult from thereon but Mominul Haque and Islam took their time, played a lot of defensive shot before building up their innings.
FOUR! Last ball before Lunch and Shadman Islam brings up his fifty as well. A solid knock from him. Shorter and on middle, Islam pulls it well in front of square on the leg side for four runs.
